body:
![Mod's Name](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46a58c91b31ccd725de6b5f697bc235f844ee2ef.png)

# !THIS MOD IS A SPIRITUAL SUCCESSOR TO BETTER INVENTORY!

This mod adds a bunch of things I just coded for fun. I recommend using JADE and REI to play it. 
The random features include:

- StarDust, an item you can get from finding a fallen star.
- Indium, a material which can be created from stardust with Purple dye.
- Indium armor and tools. (Lets you dash, double jump, and has a slim chance of aiding you when you get hit)
- Netherite Reinforced Indium armor and tools. (basically the same thing as Indium, but stronger and 2 tiers above Netherite)
- Wings that let you fly like you're in creative mode, even though you're on survival (sadly, no accessories support)
- Suitcases
- Frog Feet Enchantment that lets you double jump.
